translation: The present specialty of bone-setting (正骨科) is the condition of the ancient injuries from falls and blows (跌打損傷). It is treated entirely from the standpoint of blood; one must first distinguish whether there is stagnant blood (瘀血) accumulated, or whether there is excessive loss of blood (亡血), and only then apply the method of internal treatment, so that there will be no error. When the skin is not broken but there is internal injury, there is often stagnant blood; when the flesh is broken and the muscle (䐃) is injured, it frequently leads to excessive loss of blood.
